hashConvention: SHA-256 uppercase hex of UTF-8 canonical JSON: ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'); exclude populationManifestHash.

populationSelection.selectionReason: First three complete calendar months following the closed April-2025 S4 founder window.
populationSelection.inclusionRule: Include every distinct canonical event identity whose exactUtc is within the fixed interval and whose compiler interval satisfies startUtc <= exactUtc < endUtc.
exclusions: No S4 result-derived selection, tuning, or filtering.

admittedComponents.description: Natural planet class with source-bounded Moon and Mercury conditions.

exactPopulationHashBasis: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON for the ordered population array only.
